title: Soft Non-Maximum Suppression
seoDescription: Apply Gaussian Soft-NMS by repeatedly selecting the strongest box and decaying overlapping box scores by IoU.
description:
Decay confidence scores of overlapping candidate boxes exponentially with IoU overlap to prevent false positive suppression in dense scenes.

Hard NMS inadvertently deletes occluded true positive objects; Soft-NMS decays scores continuously, improving recall in crowded object scenes.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
s_i \leftarrow s_i \exp\left( -\frac{\operatorname{IoU}(\mathcal{M}, b_i)^2}{\sigma} \right)
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Identify highest confidence detection proposal bounding box
2. Decay overlapping candidate scores exponentially by squared IoU overlap
3. Retain proposals satisfying minimum confidence threshold

### Returns
Dictionary with 'retained_boxes' coordinates and 'decayed_scores'.
